title: UnvalidatedCandidate.v1
description: Explicit evaluation-only envelope for bytes or JSON expected to fail a named production schema.
$comment: This envelope is never a production object and must never be accepted by a production gate. candidate_sha256 is SHA-256 over UTF-8 JCS RFC8785 bytes of candidate. The runner must attempt the exact intended_schema_id from the frozen local bundle, require rejection, and compare actual rejection IDs with expected_rejection_ids. A simplified object must not declare the schema_version of the production object it imitates.
